system.description:
You retain your Dexterity bonus to your Reflex Defense regardless of being caught Flat-Footed or struck by a hidden attacker. You still lose your Dexterity bonus to your Reflex Defense if you are Immobilized.

If you are the Pilot, this Talent applies to your Vehicle.

prerequisite.text: Acute Senses talent, and Improved Initiative talent
